description: This file implements the AppNotifications plugin for WPEFramework, providing JSON-RPC methods for app notification management including subscribe, unsubscribe, publish, and list subscriptions, along with event notifications.

classes.name: AppNotifications
classes.description: Main class implementing the app notifications plugin, managing subscriptions, publishing messages, and handling JSON-RPC methods.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the service shell, loads configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the plugin is deinitialized.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information string including version.

methods.name: endpoint_ping
methods.description: Responds with 'pong' to a ping request.

methods.name: endpoint_getInfo
methods.description: Provides plugin info such as name, version, and max queue size.

methods.name: endpoint_publish
methods.description: Publishes a notification message to subscribers.

methods.name: event_notification
methods.description: Emits a notification event to clients.

methods.name: event_subscriptionchanged
methods.description: Emits an event when a subscription is changed.
